programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版：超級美味B級美食大逃亡
programme.desc: Shin-chan and the Kasukabe Defense Corps undertake a mission to carry the legendary sauce of B-class Gourmet to the B-Class carnival. The sauce is very important for B-class Gourmet. A mysterious A-Class Gourmet group led by Gourmet-Poy has taken over the carnival. Can Shin-chan and the Kasukabe Defense Corps carry out their mission and bring happiness to the ordinary people.

programme.title: 給自己的情歌
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.

programme.title: 惠子的凝視
programme.desc: Despite battling lifelong deafness, Keiko has managed to turn pro and obtain a winning record. But as her mentor faces health issues and her gym faces imminent closure due to the pandemic, Keiko finds her will to keep fighting starting to wane.

programme.title: 東極島
programme.desc: DONG JI ISLAND follows the tragic tale of a Japanese warship secretly transporting British prisoners of war and mistakenly attacked near the easternmost waters of China. To rescue the desperately trapped prisoners, a group of courageous islanders embark on a perilous journey against all odds to the sinking ship, facing relentless Japanese soldiers and the harsh, unforgiving seas..

programme.title: 鐵三角
programme.desc: Life has not been kind to Sam, Fai and Mok as they struggle to make ends meet. Routine visits to bars seem to be their only way out of miseries. Until a stormy evening when a mysterious old man appears before them with a tip: An ancient treasure is buried under the high-security Legislative Building. All they have to do is sneak in and retrieve it; if they believe in his story. Sam, Fai and Mok agree to make a run for the treasure to test their fate. What they uncover is beyond anything they expected: An ancient coffin containing a ceremonial robe made of gold..

credits.director: 徐克, 林嶺東, 杜琪峯

programme.title: 公寓裡的兩個女人
programme.desc: Yi-jung lives with her mother Su-kyung, but they do not get along well with each other. While out grocery shopping one day, they fight as usual and Su-kyung's car ends up hitting Yi-jung in the parking lot. Yi-jung does not believe Su-kyung's claim that the car suddenly accelerated on its own and thinks her mother hit her on purpose. Now, Yi-jung wants an apology from Su-kyung for everything that happened in her life.

programme.title: 告訴世界我來過
programme.desc: The 24-hour veterinary clinic acts like a bridge, witnessing the birth, separation, sickness and death of animals that human ever loved. On the contrary, also filled with our hope and despair. Some of their lives are in danger because of human's selfishness and ruthlessness. 'Once They Were Here ' tells the fate from different animals on the choice of human. Perhaps it is not pure love and random. The so-called equality of life is only reflected in the uninterrupted heartbeat.

programme.title: 人間蒸發
programme.desc: Jia Jia went to Japan with her fiance to meet her family. As soon as she arrived at the foot of Mount Fuji, she was imprisoned by local villagers and led an inhuman life. The cowardly Hirota only knew how to sorrow through wine. Jia Jia's good sister Wei Ling resolutely went to Japan to find Jia Jia. With the help of agent Kinoshita, the investigation gradually deepened, but the surrounding environment became more and more sinister. Hirota was strangled to death in a hot spring pool. Michiko went mad because of extreme fear. Yuko was still sane but unable to express when she was attacked. Tadao often spied Wei Ling through the cracks in the door. Residents under the shadow of nuclear radiation gradually lost their humanity, like a hyena, and ready to bite Wei Ling this outsider.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 戀愛大都會
programme.desc: Searching for true love in this prejudiced world. Jae-hee is a free-spirited girl who often becomes the center of rumors, while her classmate Heung-soo struggles to hide his true identity. One night at the bar district, Jae-hee discovers the other side of Heung-soo that no one else knows and helps him keep it a secret in public. As Heung-soo accidentally becomes Jae-hee's roommate, they realize that despite not being each other's ideal types, their companionship fosters a deep and strong friendship. Together, they navigate life's unexpected challenges and rely on each other like family as they courageously pursue their own paths in love and life.

programme.title: 鈴芽之旅
programme.desc: Suzume, a 17-year-old girl who lives in a quiet town in Kyushu, meets Souta, a young man looking for a door. Following Souta, Suzume finds an old door in the mountains and reaches out her hands towards the door as if pulled by something. This opened door will bring disaster; thus, Souta must travel around to lock the door to avoid disaster. But then, a mysterious kitten turns Souta into a broken wooden chair. To catch the kitten, Suzume and Souta follow it and travel from Kyushu to Tokyo. “Doors of disaster” begin to appear across Japan simultaneously, and Suzume needs to close and lock the doors one by one to stop the disasters. Unexpectedly, a forgotten truth is waiting for her.

programme.title: 來福大酒店
programme.desc: To raise funds for his father, Sanqing, who has faced social ostracism, goes undercover at the Life Hotel near the hospital, aiming to disrupt its operations and coerce owner Xiao Lin into agreeing to its demolition. However, as they spend time together, Sanqing forms bonds with the hotel's residents and learns of the guests' life stories. His internal conflict escalates, turning a simple undercover assignment into a matter of personal integrity. The hotel's destiny impacts not only its inhabitants but also Sanqing's longing for home. Yet, his indecision triggers a deeper crisis..

programme.title: 體驗撈金魚吧
programme.desc: Makoto Kashiba is angry and depressed after losing his job as an elite banker and being sent to the countryside. By chance (Or is it fate?) he meets a beautiful girl, Kitsuno. However, the man she's in love with is master pianist and goldfish catcher, Noboru Oji. Bonds between them form, and a love triangle begins..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: JSA安全地帶
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight..

programme.title: 吹哨人
programme.desc: An earthquake of 6.6 magnitude strikes Malawi in southeast Africa. Eco Energy Technology, an Australian energy conglomerate with business in the region, sends its rescue team for emergency response. Meanwhile, in an exclusive resort in Australia, Chinese expatriate Mark (Lei Jiayin) runs into his ex-lover Wen (Tang Wei), now married to the chairman of Han Coal Group. Their old feelings rush back but soon he is dragged into something bigger with Wen... and turn into a night of passion, before Wen flies off to China in the morning. That afternoon, Mark is devastated to learn that the plane Wen took has crashed, with no sign of survivors. Two weeks have passed. Mark is trying to leave the past behind, when a mysterious call puts him in limbo. Mark discovers Wen cheats death after failing to catch the flight. Before figuring out the next step, they are tracked down by killers wherever they flee. Someone obviously wants her dead for good. Hopelessly outpowered, Mark pledges to pro.

programme.title: 藍色巨星
programme.desc: Miyamoto Dai, a student with a passion for basketball, has an overnight life-changing experience after going to a jazz show for the first time. As if hypnotised by this music he knows nothing about, the young man decides to devote himself heart and soul to the saxophone and jazz becomes his new passion. Will he succeed in becoming a great musician.

programme.title: 空心人
programme.desc: Ming & Cheng have a son named Won. One day, Won suddenly had a persistent high fever. As a result, Won died due to lack of rescue. She was very sad and thought that Won was still alive. Then, they meet a person name Xia, who could help people heal the pain of losing their loved ones, Xia gave Cheng a doll, which seemed to be just an ordinary doll, but when it reached her hands, the doll turned into Won. But in Ming eyes, he was just a doll. Xia reminds Ming that this doll must not be damaged. Since then, they have lived happily ever after. But Ming began to feel that Cheng was too obsessed with this illusion and felt that the doll was getting spooky and became an unknown object. He could not stand it and secretly destroyed the doll, but what he didn't expect that Cheng still regarded the broken doll as Won. She thought that he killed her son. Ming started arguing with her, hoping to wake her up, but accidentally injured Cheng, then unexpectedly something happened to Ming..

programme.title: 異山怪談
programme.desc: Members of 'GO2MOUNTAIN' bike riding club try valleys of Mount CHIAK where unreal too-cleanly-cut mutilation murders happened. Moments of freedom riding the mountain, odd things happen around them. Will they survive through what that haunts.

programme.title: 奪命金
programme.desc: “Life Without Principle” tells the story of three ordinary citizens, bank teller Teresa, triad thug Panther and Police inspector Cheung Jin Fong, whose lives are turned upside down by a bizarre robbery. Hammered by the predicaments of their respective lives, what are their choices between money and principles.

programme.title: 夏日福星
programme.desc: Muscles, Kidstuff, Fung, and the gang taking a well-needed vacation in Thailand courtesy of the Hong Kong police department. Also on the trip is police inspector Woo on orders to track down a list of drug dealers from informant Ma. Unfortunately, Ma gets whacked by a Thai crime lord, but he tells Woo as he draws his last breath that he mailed the list to his friend in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, Muscles and the gang are shaking down Lau, a drug dealer who, it turns out, is being targeted by the same baddies that killed Ma..

programme.title: 唐伯虎點秋香
programme.desc: Tong Park Foo is the top-grade scholar in Suzhou. On a feast day, Tong and his friends go to visit the temple and there, Tong meets Chau Heung for the first time. Tong is shaken at Chau's beauty. He decides to go after her. But Chau's master Mrs. Wah is very angry with Tong's family, how can Tong make Chau Heung his bride.

programme.title: 影人映語 -詞「得」達意 - 黎彼得
programme.desc: Although a lot of people recognize Peter Lai mostly from his TV drama's performance, he is arguably one of the veteran lyricists in Hong Kong music industry. Looking back from ‘Choi San Dou' to ‘Monica', his lyrics have definitely contributed the success of numerous well-known immortals. Why would he become an actor while debuted as a lyricist? Worked with so many famous stars, what related interesting stories he is going to reveal to us.

programme.title: 猛鬼差館
programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.

programme.title: 流氓公僕
programme.desc: Bill and Lee are a pair of old hands working with the Action Squad in the Police Department. They both have their shortcomings. Bill likes to bet a bit to lighten up and Lee likes to flirt with pretty girls. But their little tales do not in anyway interfere with their dedication towards their work. Unfortunately for them, a Pl Mak is newly appointed as their squad leader. To make matter worse, the new inspector is female. Bill and Lee have to adjust in a hurry how the new inspector likes to handle cases her way..

programme.title: 南海十三郎
programme.desc: The movie bases itself on the life of 'Naam Hoi Sap Saam Long' who was a gifted, famed and productive playwright in the 1930s.

programme.title: 猛鬼撞鬼
programme.desc: Taxi dancer Yue puts herself head over heels in debt because of gambling. She tries to borrow a loan from her close friend, Ngor, with tricks of suicide. She pretendedly pushes Ngor down a tall building but falls from the rooftop herself. She has got a narrow escape and a windfall of picking up a sack of money from a Chinese spiritualized vase which belongs to a big brother, Hung. With the help of the spirit, Yue and Ngor win so much that they almost lose their sense. They want to keep the vase themselves so they must get away from the pursuit of a killer sent by Hung, as well as another two mysterious detectives..

programme.title: 皇家戰士
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong policewoman, a Japanese Interpol agent and an air security officer botch a plane hijacking attempt by a militia fanatic, his veteran friends vow revenge. In order to stop the terrorist attacks and also to save their own lives, the three heroes must team up once again to fight their gun-toting adversaries.

programme.title: 正牌韋小寶之奉旨溝女
programme.desc: Imperial Court member Wai Siu-Bo is sent forward in time to present-day Hong Kong, to find a woman who can cure the Emperor of his illness. Can Siu-Bo accomplish his mission.

programme.title: 西環的故事
programme.desc: The rough and tough Kennedy Town. And three young men, Chiang, Peng and Wei, came to the scene. Chiang and Wei help Peng to become a policeman. Chiang and Wei also provide the information which enables Peng to crack a few cases. Then Chiang and Wei kill a gangster by accident. Chiang decides to surrender himself to Peng and jail. Peng, however, takes over Chiang's girlfriend. Chiang comes out from jail, Peng plots to get rid of all gangland chief, Chiang and Wei inclusive..

programme.title: 星願
programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive.

programme.title: 原始武器
programme.desc: A brutal murder occurs in the moonlight: a masked killer and his two accompanies execute a couple in an extremely sadistic way. Organized crime investigators KWAN, LEE and LING start to investigate into the case promptly. LING has a charming character and both men are in love with her. LING faces a dilemma and decides to give both men a fair competition. No sooner have they resolved the love triangle that they face great disasters. On the wedding night of LING and LEE, three masked killers break into their house, slay LEE and force LING to engage in S. M..

programme.title: 夏日福星
programme.desc: Muscles, Kidstuff, Fung, and the gang taking a well-needed vacation in Thailand courtesy of the Hong Kong police department. Also on the trip is police inspector Woo on orders to track down a list of drug dealers from informant Ma. Unfortunately, Ma gets whacked by a Thai crime lord, but he tells Woo as he draws his last breath that he mailed the list to his friend in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, Muscles and the gang are shaking down Lau, a drug dealer who, it turns out, is being targeted by the same baddies that killed Ma..

programme.title: 亡命鴛鴦
programme.desc: Crack policeman Hsiang Ming is having a talk with his separated wife when a bullet from hired killer Ah Chui kills the wife, an anti-drug policewoman. Hsiang Ming goes after the killer but is told to keep off by senior officer Lu. In fact, Lu is head of a narcotics ring and lover of Hsiang Ming's ex-wife. She knows his secret, thus Lu hires Ah Chui to kill her. Then Lu sets about to kill every one connected with crime-the go-between and Ah Chui. On his death bed, the go-between tells Hsiang Ming where to find Ah Chui. This Hsiang Ming does. But Lu's men are coming to kill both of them. Hsiang Ming has to fight off the attackers. Hsiang Ming takes Ah Chui to his mother-in-law's house where Ah Chui meets Hsiang Ming's daughter and feels shameful. When Lu's men come, she saves the young girl and an injured Hsiang Ming. As Hsiang Ming's friends fail to stop Lu, Ah Chui takes Hsiang Ming to a secret hide out and nurses him. They become lovers..

programme.title: 冒險王
programme.desc: “The Scripture With No Words” had been lost for a long time. Everybody was eager to find it, even the ambitious Japanese. Dr. Wai was antiquarian. Having seen the mysterious “Wooden Horse”, lost control and killing people, he quit his job. However, being supported by his friend, Dr. Wai recovered and resumed to his work. He went to Shanghai trying to locate “The Scripture With No Words” and he discovered that it was in the possession of the leader of “Gang of Salt”. And the game begin..

programme.title: 陰陽錯
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. He is surprised to learn that the victim is the same ghost who has spoken to him the night before. Koo is fascinated in working on the case. One night, Yu's spirit appeared in Koo's apartment. Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?

programme.title: 重案組
programme.desc: Eddie Chan, a guilt-ridden cop trying to silence his demons from a recent shoot-out who is assigned to rescue kidnapped businessman Huang Yifei. It is a trail that leads Chan and his partner, Hung from Hong Kong to Taipei and back to Hong Kong. As the trail gets warmer, Chan begins to suspect that there are internal forces – including Hung – who seem to working against him..

programme.title: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May..

programme.title: 風雲雄霸天下
programme.desc: Nie Feng (Wind) and Bu Jingyun (Cloud) are raised by Xiong Ba of World Society, helping him to conquer the world. But Xiong Ba is their mutual enemy who killed their fathers..

programme.title: 雜家小子
programme.desc: Little John and brother Big John make a living out of crooked exploits and swindling. Their tricks turn sour and they find themselves stripped of cash with nowhere to turn. Desperate for protection, they scurry under the wings of mysterious master, only to pay a heavy price when they discover their master is a con man with a violent past..

programme.title: 賭俠
programme.desc: Little Knife is following in his master's footsteps and rapidly rising in th gambling world. Sing Chi would like to be the God of Gamblers' disciple and ask him for help..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 賭俠2之上海灘賭聖
programme.desc: Coming back learning from the God of Gambler, Star accidentally falls into a time tunnel and back to Shanghai in 1937, where he meets his grandfather Fook, Yvonne and Danny..

programme.title: 飛虎
programme.desc: Wong and his team are forced to team up with a bungling customs squad and their greenhorn leader, who happens to be a woman, to bring in a huge shipment of heroine..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之二男兒當自強
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: 超級學校霸王
programme.desc: In the year 2043, the notorious villain is about to be put on trial. His killers decide to go back 50 years by the time tunnel, and look for the judge in his youthful age..

programme.title: 陰陽錯
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. He is surprised to learn that the victim is the same ghost who has spoken to him the night before. Koo is fascinated in working on the case. One night, Yu's spirit appeared in Koo's apartment. Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?

programme.title: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May..

programme.title: 影人映語 -洪家班靠「搏」出位 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: In the last episode, Sammo Hung shared his story of being an action-choreographer, director and actor for over half a century in the film industry. Now he is going to talk more about apprenticeship with his master Yu Jim-yuen whom he learned the martial arts philosophy from and his journey of growing next-generation action stars; also give us an insight into the challenges towards Hong Kong action film nowadays.

programme.title: 龍的心
programme.desc: It's the two brothers of Hong Kong action as you have never seen them before in a gripping drama where the lines blur between family loyalty and upholding the law. Jackie Chan plays Ted, a SWAT officer with thwarted dreams of being a sailor because he has to look after his mentally disabled brother Danny. The resentment boils over in a terse showdown between the two brothers. When Danny accidentally ends up with a robbery loot while playing a harmless game of cops and robbers with his friends, Ted has to make an agonizing decision. Does he save the hapless Danny? Or arrest him.

programme.title: 雜家小子
programme.desc: Little John and brother Big John make a living out of crooked exploits and swindling. Their tricks turn sour and they find themselves stripped of cash with nowhere to turn. Desperate for protection, they scurry under the wings of mysterious master, only to pay a heavy price when they discover their master is a con man with a violent past..

programme.title: 新英雄本色
programme.desc: Cool and brave, Tong is the most famous big brother. Ha, a loyal follower of Tong, is charged murdering his unfaithful wife's lover. Fortunately, he is saved by Tong's lawyer..

programme.title: 霹靂先鋒
programme.desc: Cheung Tit-hong has recorded numerous meritorious deeds, but he is by nature uncontrollable and antagonistic to his bureaucratic superiors. Before reporting his work to his superiors, he has already successfully arrested the gangsters who steal motorbikes. He also saved an innocent teacher from being wrongly accused of theft by recognizing a female pickpocket. Finally, he has subdued fierce armed robbers in the gambling casino by flexibly utilizing a car thief, Boy. The contradictions in working style between Cheung and his superiors naturally lead to numerous scenes of strong conflicts..

programme.title: 影人映語 -點解「吳式」笑 － 吳君如
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer.

programme.title: 你OK，我OK
programme.desc: Twenty-five year old Liang Shao Chiang leads a boring life working as an auditor in a big finance corporation. He only has eyes for the receptionist Chow Yun-Lan. Chow is young and pretty, and is the natural target for the bunch of horny men around her. But she is pert and secretive, and no one is able to get even a date from her. Liang has fallen deeper and deeper for Chow. Alas this love is not reciprocative. But suddenly there is a breakthrough in his career, for four managers of the company is recommending a promotion for him! Of course, there is a price behind this - Liang has to let them use his bachelor apartment for conducting love affairs! Soon this scandal travels to the ears of the general manager Mr. Lui..

programme.title: 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger..

programme.title: 龍虎風雲
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat plays Ko Chow, a police undercover agent who is torn between his duty as a police officer and his loyalty to his friends on the wrong side of the law.

programme.title: 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots..

programme.title: 逃學威龍三之龍過雞年
programme.desc: The Millionaire, Million Wong, is found dead in a hotelroom. The police head officer, Mr. Ta Wang Lai, orders Chau Sing Sing to be an undercover again for further investigation.

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲：國色天「姿」: 飛躍羚羊
programme.desc: Alias “Springing Gazelle”, the renowned athlete Miss Chi Cheng is in Hong Kong helping to organize a training programme and hunt for a coach. Olivia was a former brilliant sprinter who has to give up running after her injury in a competition. At the beginning of the training, the girls are too pompous that they despise Olivia, until they find that Olivia is beyond their challenge, they adore her and are willing to go through the hardship but after a winning contest, they feel hostility towards each other and behave proudly. As a result, they lost in the competition with Singapore team. Olivia is so furious..

credits.director: 鄭則士, 司徒立光, 譚鋭銘

programme.title: 玻璃樽
programme.desc: C.N. faces his greatest challenge when he meets young country girl Bu and falls in love! But when Howie sets a trap for him, C.N. must prepare to fight for his lady and his life.

programme.title: 阿金
programme.desc: Ah Kam is from Mainland China and is trained in kung fu. She becomes a double in Hong Kong. Tung and his partners of the Tung's Family, a stunt man group, cannot work as stuntmen after an ambush. Tung lets Kam try being the stunt director and Kam becomes very popular. Kam married Sam and moves to Shenzhen to look after Sam's karaoke business. However, being a karaoke manager does not suit Kam. At the same time, Sam is unfaithful and so Kam returns to the movie industry and once again becomes a stuntwoman..

programme.title: 金枝玉葉2
programme.desc: With the help of her lover, Sam, Wing impersonated a male image and became a pop singer. But Fong Yim Mui wrecked the relationship when they both had an affair with her..

programme.title: 半斤八兩
programme.desc: Joseph Wong (Michael Hui), the kingpin of the Manix Private Detective Agency, a firm believer in tact and thrift. By tact, he means you can cheat all the people all the time and corners are there to be cut. By thrift, he means an underpaid staff is happy and grateful staff. Scores of gun-toting hoods hold the more than 1,000 goers as hostages. On the stage Uncle Gaw (Shek Kin) threatens that it is a hold-up.

programme.title: 奸人本色
programme.desc: Leung Piu a swindler, cheats Yue Nan out of his life savings. This leads to Yue Nan's death, leaving his daughter Winnie behind. The Kang family, long disgusted by Leung's treachery, vow to avenge Yue Nan. They decide to “fight deceit with deceit”, exploiting Leung's greed to lure him into a trap, but Leung outsmarts Kang family. As the conflict escalates, Leung continuously sows discord between Kang's brothers Mon and Chuen. When Leung believes he has triumphed by triggering infighting within Kang family..

programme.title: 城市獵人

With the help from his jealous assistant Carrie, undercover agent Saeko and gambler Gundam, Ryo must foil the nefarious plot.

programme.title: 賭聖2之街頭賭聖

Master Kao upon hearing his God daughter and his only son's death seeks Wing to avenger their cruel death..

programme.desc: Young Har Jay starts as a waitress in a low-class restaurant. Like all young girls, she falls for handsome young men. One of them makes her pregnant. Later on, she becomes the head hostess of a cabaret and is famous for the way she trains inexperienced girls. Buwhay, Har Jay's daughter, grows up and revolts. She goes for an upstart mobster, Chao, and runs away from Har Jay..

Only her fiance Michael comes to welcome her back, but Jacky and Carol, her good friends and married couple, fail to appear. Jacky Chan, a cartoonist, is in fact a long-time cocaine doper and is therefore deeply in debts. Sam, one of the hired thugs of the drug-dealer constantly comes to collect debts. It greatly irritates Carol. Michael goes so far as to collaborate with the drug dealer for benefits. Moreover, he supplies cocaine to Jacky once in a while. Jacky is under the delusion that cocaine inhalation will help him gain inspiration in cartoon-drawing, but contrarily, cocaine only makes him get into real trouble. He resorts to satisfy his urge for drugs by snatching his wife's money and accidentally hurts her. Carol ultimately tells the whole story in tears to Maggie..

Pitt finally finds an eyewitness to the killing - Fat Goose who is persuaded to testify against the killer Lam Man Fu. Lam Man Fu chases and attacks Pitt and Fat Goose. Finally, Pitt arrests him but Superintendent Keung frees Lam Man Fu and removes Pitt from the case. Then Lam Man Fu firebombs Fat Goose's residence. Fat Goose moves into Pitt's home and strikes a fast friendship with Angel, Pitt's reporter sister..

programme.title: 影人映語 -方丈的闊達 - 劉以達
programme.desc: After formed the musical group “Tat Ming Pair”, Tats Lau had been involved as a film composer in the industry for the first time. His taciturn image was changing over when he was invited by Stephen Chow to have a cameo in one of his works; then Lau's another role playing the abbot even provided a major boost to his career as a comedy actor. How does he feel when looking back at his experience throughout these years? Also, perceiving that Hong Kong is his ‘root', what kind of wisdom he would like to share with the audience.

programme.title: 大內密探零零發
programme.desc: Fat is a neglected member of 'The King's Guardian'. Kam dynasty uses an excuse to assassinate the Emperor. 'Fat' smells the trouble and go along secretly to protect the Emperor..

programme.title: 錢作怪
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor..

programme.desc: An army deserter Di Ming Qi, who was chased by vampires in the mountain of Zu. He was rescued by Master Ding Yin and became his pupil. When they were ambushed by the Blood Devil, devil chaser Xiao Ru and his pupil Yi Zhen came to their assistance. With the help of Master Chang Mei, they managed to hold off the Blood Devil but they need to find the Dual Swords to destroy it. Master Ding took the wounded Xiao Ru to Celestial Fort and sought help from the Mistress, but was in turned poisoned by the Blood Devil and he surrendered to the Dark Force. Will Di and Yi Chen find the Dual Swords and destroy the Blood Devil.

programme.title: 與龍共舞
programme.desc: Aaron, a young, successful Chinese businessman, drifts on to a rural island after a scuba accident. Mistaken for an illegal immigrant, he is forced to take refuge in a small, family-run grocery store. Enjoying the riches to rags transition, he tells nobody his true identity, and falls in love with the grocery store owner's daughter, Yvonne. But while Aaron enjoys his life of anonymity, Yvonne covets the chance to escape her poverty.

programme.title: 扭計雜牌軍
programme.desc: Four sworn brothers failed heist and get into jail for years. Sheng is set free. The three ask Sheng to get the hidden loot and wait for their eventual reunion. Sheng discovers the loot has disappeared but the other three are convinced Sheng has stolen it. Sheng has to escape. His childhood lover Chuan tries to help him to go overseas but is hurt when Sheng falls for insurance detective Bonnie. Sheng and Bonnie buy tickets from Liang who is left holding the bag when his boss absconds with the money..

programme.title: 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..

programme.title: 三人世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, just breaks up with his model girlfriend Peggy. In order to release Alex's anxiety, his friend invites him to be the part time director of a choir. Alex meets Vivian in the choir. However, Vivian's mother Chu Lai Ngo, a divorced woman who dislikes Alex at the first sight. When Alex and Chu are getting closer and closer, they imperceptibly fall in love with each other. At this moment, Peggy suddenly comes back to Alex asking for being together once again. Alex has to make his choice of love between these two women..

programme.title: 鍾無艷
programme.desc: On his hunting trip, Emperor Qi takes a wrong turn and is confronted by bandit leader/wild beauty Wu Yen. The two are immediately attracted to each other. However, an ugly mole on Wu Yen's face thwarts this match made in heaven. Emperor Qi cancels the wedding for fear of marrying someone ugly. The mole is the result of a 'love spell' put by enchantress Yin Chun, who is actually an incarnation of a 3000-years old fox with great magical power..

programme.title: 阿郎的故事
programme.desc: Ah Long is a car racing fanatic who is in love with Ah Kar. Ignoring her mother's advice, Ah Kar decides to marry Ah Long. Tragic follows by this illegal car racing contest..

programme.title: 國色天「姿」: 戀戰沖繩
programme.desc: Jenny wakes up and decides to leave her lover Sato, a triad boss. She takes Sato's ransom money to Tang, who has a diary with explicit details of Sato's triad activities.

programme.title: 情聖
programme.desc: Shing and Betty want to find money to pay back the loan shark. They break into a house and prepare to steal the valuable items in it. Old Bill, who also owes debts to the loan shark, happens to be in the house. He pretends to be the owner, because he thinks Shing is a wealthy man that he could cheat him for money. Eventually, they find out each other's real identity and cooperate to set plans and trap the loan shark.

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Western Australia’s Murchison GeoRegion is well known for its’ ancient landscapes and\nbrilliant skies, this is the real outback. We take a journey through a region full of stories dating back to\nthe earth’s beginning, around 4½ billion years ago.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New
South Wales, taking in The Great Divide on our way to the Great Australian Outback. Magnificent
landscapes, awesome attractions, and we meet some really cool people as we make our way through
a region which traditional owners are spiritually connected to.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: After Bangladesh, Rooftop and Catfish explore the country of Japan next. They test out their careers as sumo wrestlers and ninjas (though they learn they should probably stick to BMX), eat pufferfish, a delicacy outlawed everywhere else in Asia, and try to handle Japan’s bondage culture from a dominatrix. They join in on a game of Bo Taoshi, and get saline injections to fit in with Japan’s nightlife. Before they head out from their Japanese adventures, Rooftop and Catfish finish the trip learning how to drift and even attempt jumping into their drifting car. After such an action packed visit to Japan, where will the duo’s travels take them next.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish explore Indonesia in a fiery way. The duo test out their manhoods with leech therapy, wall jumping, participating in a traditional whip dance, and trying the ancient martial art of debus. They then slow down for a moment to stop and smell the Indonesian fruit durian and cut one out of a tree to taste test. Finally their Indonesian adventure ends with a game of flaming soccer in the streets and sulfur mining in the mouth of a volcano. With all of these wild and dangerous activities, can Rooftop and Catfish handle the heat of Indonesia.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第1季
programme.desc: Half of Mongolia lives in this city. And they drive their cars like they ride their horses: fast and furious.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation 第2季
programme.desc: When Dick Cabela founded “Cabela’s”, he was unaware that it was to become the foremost outfitting store in the world. So it is fitting that his son is on a quest to explore the Hard Truths of conservation. Join Dan Cabela on this high-impact journey of discovery as he uncovers some of lesser known facts in the conservation world. In particular, the role that hunting and the utilization of wildlife can play as a modern day conservation tool.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Gareth Southgate 第1季
programme.desc: In Bear’s Mission with Gareth Southgate, the leader of the Three Lions squad will swap the football field for some of the UK’s toughest terrain and tackle the ultimate challenge, as he joins Bear on a mission across the wilds of Dartmoor.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: This week a heavy rescue like no other – as father and son Dave and Adam Crouch team up to save a lorry transporting a train from sinking into soft ground. Crouch Recovery Op Jim must rescue a lorry from a ditch after the driver attempted an ill-advised three-point turn. And while Rory moves an antique fire engine for the boss, Fluff must get rid of a lorry load of stinking cheese.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: The white sand beaches and emerald green waters of Destin, Florida are the setting for the 'World's Luckiest Fishing Villages.' Beneath the water's surface, it's a different story...one of the most formidable species, the lionfish, has been wreaking havoc on the local ecosystem for decades. The ecological advantage of the lionfish is its venomous spikes, used to corner prey and protect itself from predators, and giving it an advantage over native fish. Luckily, local conservationists and fishing captains discovered years ago that lionfish are as tasty as they are dangerous. Yia joins local biologist Alex Fogg as he works to mitigate the lionfish's damage by harvesting them one buttery, flaky bite at a time.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: The feral hog is one of the most formidable species on the planet. Possessing a unique combination of high reproductive capacity, size, and adaptability, the feral hog absolutely decimates entire ecosystems. With pork chops on his mind, Yia travels to the Florida/Alabama border to join Jennifer Bearden and Zack Franks who are doing their part to help control the rampant feral hog population menacing Florida.

programme.title: Search4Hurt 第4季
programme.desc: After online qualifiers six male and female athletes take on the last test to claim their spot on Team S4H, that test is HurtCamp.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Western Australia’s Murchison GeoRegion is well known for its’ ancient landscapes and\nbrilliant skies, this is the real outback. We take a journey through a region full of stories dating back to\nthe earth’s beginning, around 4½ billion years ago.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New
South Wales, taking in The Great Divide on our way to the Great Australian Outback. Magnificent
landscapes, awesome attractions, and we meet some really cool people as we make our way through
a region which traditional owners are spiritually connected to.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled 第1季
programme.desc: Sara goes to Melbourne to explore the food culture and find the best local ingredients. First stop, the Queen Victoria Market.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled 第1季
programme.desc: Sara heads to Victoria where she visits the farms and wineries, which she finds after travelling inland from the Great Ocean Road. She is planning to visit the restaurant Brae, which is run by an unknown chef.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第1季
programme.desc: Half of Mongolia lives in this city. And they drive their cars like they ride their horses: fast and furious.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: This week a heavy rescue like no other – as father and son Dave and Adam Crouch team up to save a lorry transporting a train from sinking into soft ground. Crouch Recovery Op Jim must rescue a lorry from a ditch after the driver attempted an ill-advised three-point turn. And while Rory moves an antique fire engine for the boss, Fluff must get rid of a lorry load of stinking cheese.

programme.desc: Half of Mongolia lives in this city. And they drive their cars like they ride their horses: fast and furious.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode a 40-ton lorry rammed full of scrap metal overturns and spills its steel load across a major A road during rush hour, and Lantern recovery op Steve Knight is called to the scene. 25 tonnes of metal must be removed from the lorry before it can be lifted and with a damaged 5th wheel, it’s a job that will push Steve and his team to the limit. At Crouch HQ there’s excitement in the air as the team give trucking superfan Chris and his disabled daughter, the ride of his life by taking him to his wedding in a big orange truck. Late at night, recovery op Snod is called to the side of the M69 to recover two crashed cars. With one on its side with the hand brake off, he must take care righting it to make sure it doesn’t roll into the passing traffic. It’s particularly tough job for Snod as his friend was killed on the same stretch of road whilst recovering a vehicle.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: This week a heavy rescue like no other – as father and son Dave and Adam Crouch team up to save a lorry transporting a train from sinking into soft ground. Crouch Recovery Op Jim must rescue a lorry from a ditch after the driver attempted an ill-advised three-point turn. And while Rory moves an antique fire engine for the boss, Fluff must get rid of a lorry load of stinking cheese.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation 第2季
programme.desc: When Dick Cabela founded “Cabela’s”, he was unaware that it was to become the foremost outfitting store in the world. So it is fitting that his son is on a quest to explore the Hard Truths of conservation. Join Dan Cabela on this high-impact journey of discovery as he uncovers some of lesser known facts in the conservation world. In particular, the role that hunting and the utilization of wildlife can play as a modern day conservation tool.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In China, Rooftop and Catfish continue their East Asian adventures. As if the leeches in Indonesia weren’t enough, the bikers move on to bee sting therapy in China, strengthen their stomachs with some grasshoppers and mice wine, and attempt to transport hundreds of pounds of fish on nothing but a bike and sheer will power. The duo also undergo a hike of Chinese mountain Hua Shan, electro acupuncture, and kung fu train, all to be able to endure dim mak, ‘the death touch.’ Can Rooftop and Catfish handle this intense physical journey, or will the death touch get the best of them.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Off to Vietnam next, Rooftop and Catfish embark on what may be their most dangerous visit yet. The BMX bikers start their journey relatively tame with a shot of snake blood. However, things quickly escalate from there with the most intense game of frogger they’ve ever played in the Vietnamese streets. From a hospital visit and racing through the Vietcong tunnels to trying fertilized baby bird eggs and relaxing in a boiling hot spring, nothing can prepare the duo for the ending of their trip heading to the demilitarized zone to detonate bombs. After this trip to Vietnam, what more heart-racing adventures and Rooftop and Catfish possibly find.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty 'Wildman' Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: A once sought-after pet, the green iguanas escaped their terrariums in the 60's and found the Florida eco-system to be a much more hospitable environment to call home. Free to roam the canals, parks, and suburban neighborhoods, these pets-gone-feral have exploded in both size and population, causing hundreds of millions of dollars of damage a year in Florida. Urban hunter Michael Onega is doing his part to clean up the environment by removing as many iguanas as possible, limiting their population spread. The singular goal - to make sure the iguanas never establish a healthy breeding population in the Everglades. Yia joins Michael and his trusty Labrador Scout on Michael's mud boat, as they patrol the canals in Michael's backyard. The only thing better than Scout retrieving the fallen iguanas, are BBQed iguana and iguana tacos cooked up in Michael's backyard.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第1季
programme.desc: Lima is known as the Garden City, but driving here definitely isn't a walk in the park.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Gareth Southgate 第1季
programme.desc: In Bear’s Mission with Gareth Southgate, the leader of the Three Lions squad will swap the football field for some of the UK’s toughest terrain and tackle the ultimate challenge, as he joins Bear on a mission across the wilds of Dartmoor.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第1季
programme.desc: Lima is known as the Garden City, but driving here definitely isn't a walk in the park.

programme.title: Making Pandas 第1季
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast.\nOver 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. \nThe team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast.\nOver 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. \nThe team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

programme.desc: Daniel and Arthur angle for lake white fish with their wives Avani and Sara, and gather wild salad ingredients on a remote lake in Maine.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty 'Wildman' Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: A once sought-after pet, the green iguanas escaped their terrariums in the 60's and found the Florida eco-system to be a much more hospitable environment to call home. Free to roam the canals, parks, and suburban neighborhoods, these pets-gone-feral have exploded in both size and population, causing hundreds of millions of dollars of damage a year in Florida. Urban hunter Michael Onega is doing his part to clean up the environment by removing as many iguanas as possible, limiting their population spread. The singular goal - to make sure the iguanas never establish a healthy breeding population in the Everglades. Yia joins Michael and his trusty Labrador Scout on Michael's mud boat, as they patrol the canals in Michael's backyard. The only thing better than Scout retrieving the fallen iguanas, are BBQed iguana and iguana tacos cooked up in Michael's backyard.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation 第2季
programme.desc: When Dick Cabela founded “Cabela’s”, he was unaware that it was to become the foremost outfitting store in the world. So it is fitting that his son is on a quest to explore the Hard Truths of conservation. Join Dan Cabela on this high-impact journey of discovery as he uncovers some of lesser known facts in the conservation world. In particular, the role that hunting and the utilization of wildlife can play as a modern day conservation tool.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken\nby European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in\nthe very interior of the country.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In China, Rooftop and Catfish continue their East Asian adventures. As if the leeches in Indonesia weren’t enough, the bikers move on to bee sting therapy in China, strengthen their stomachs with some grasshoppers and mice wine, and attempt to transport hundreds of pounds of fish on nothing but a bike and sheer will power. The duo also undergo a hike of Chinese mountain Hua Shan, electro acupuncture, and kung fu train, all to be able to endure dim mak, ‘the death touch.’ Can Rooftop and Catfish handle this intense physical journey, or will the death touch get the best of them.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Off to Vietnam next, Rooftop and Catfish embark on what may be their most dangerous visit yet. The BMX bikers start their journey relatively tame with a shot of snake blood. However, things quickly escalate from there with the most intense game of frogger they’ve ever played in the Vietnamese streets. From a hospital visit and racing through the Vietcong tunnels to trying fertilized baby bird eggs and relaxing in a boiling hot spring, nothing can prepare the duo for the ending of their trip heading to the demilitarized zone to detonate bombs. After this trip to Vietnam, what more heart-racing adventures and Rooftop and Catfish possibly find.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this week's episode Simon must grapple with a juggernaut that has skidded off the M62 and down a steep bank, but when they finally manage to pull it back onto the carriageway, it starts leaking diesel. Jim battles to rescue a car transporter stuck in a muddy layby, and his new best buddy, rookie driver Warren, faces a tricky tractor unit recovery on the side of a dual carriageway. Meanwhile, Rory must deal with a mobile library that’s been the victim of a shocking arson attack, and Fluff finds himself in a quandary in a quarry – rescuing a broken-down tipper truck.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A broken-down coach on a slip road of the motorway presents a major problem for Crouch recovery op Jon and Highways England. Recovery Op Marta and Tez work together to solve a serious weight issue on her trailer load. Lantern Recovery Op Scott attends a road collision to find a trailer too damaged to tow – with the sun going down, will he get off the highway before darkness falls.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty 'Wildman' Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: A once sought-after pet, the green iguanas escaped their terrariums in the 60's and found the Florida eco-system to be a much more hospitable environment to call home. Free to roam the canals, parks, and suburban neighborhoods, these pets-gone-feral have exploded in both size and population, causing hundreds of millions of dollars of damage a year in Florida. Urban hunter Michael Onega is doing his part to clean up the environment by removing as many iguanas as possible, limiting their population spread. The singular goal - to make sure the iguanas never establish a healthy breeding population in the Everglades. Yia joins Michael and his trusty Labrador Scout on Michael's mud boat, as they patrol the canals in Michael's backyard. The only thing better than Scout retrieving the fallen iguanas, are BBQed iguana and iguana tacos cooked up in Michael's backyard.

歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：初一不見了
programme.desc: 初一對口才班始終沒有興趣，偷偷跑出來，在隔壁繪畫班看入了神。景婷婷發現初一不見了，心急如焚。轉眼看到初一從隔壁繪畫班出來才心安。看到初一的畫作，眾人都感歎她的畫畫天賦，景婷婷和楊明彪一致給初一換成繪畫班.

programme.title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團山東篇 — 曲阜、泰安
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.

programme.title: 灣區夢成真
programme.desc: 高中組（趙聿修紀念中學）學生設計的大灣區行程，開展Day 1與Day 2行程，探索廣州佛山文化與科技，通過遊戲與資訊展現大灣區的傳統與現代.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 晨光初破，城市蘇醒，細膩如紗的「舞者」飄散出第一縷香氣。當輕柔的面片經過發酵的魔法變得鬆軟而有彈性，當第一次有人將菜或肉包裹其中而食，一種便捷小巧蘊藏無限驚喜的食物出現。早餐包點，口味多變，均衡的營養組合又不失嚴謹，它是早餐界的「顯眼包」，和朝陽共舞，只要一口咬下，喚醒味蕾的樂章便悄然流淌.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 湯，這種古老的食品，卻在現代人的早餐中意外「翻紅」。不論是南方的雋永清澈，還是北方的踏實飽腹，湯總是以海納百川的包容性，迎合著每一個地方的食俗、每一種口味的變化。一碗湯下肚，從舌尖暖到心底.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 阿花的任務是要把魔杖帶到回收中心，但她為了趕赴野餐而沒有完成任務，果造成一場魔法災難。最後，英雄們需要暫停野餐並執行拯救森林的任務.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米和小麥在寵物雞嬌嬌的窩裡發現一顆蛋，帶著小雞回到史前時代。姐弟倆在恐龍廣場尋找蛋的失主，拜訪多位恐龍朋友，卻無法找到。正當失去信心時，小恐龍破殼而出.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米和茜茜在後院踢毽子，沒有帶小麥。小麥接到恐龍召喚後加入。在史前世界，胖殼感到身份危機，哭著跑開。朋友們找到他，讓他感受到歸屬感。回家後，小米和茜茜邀請小麥一起玩，大家都很開心.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 兄妹倆都想獨佔房間，灶君利用神環相助，表面是幫他們解決煩惱，實際是想讓倆人反思並為對方着想；另一邊，灶君對落戶趙家心有不甘，準備偷偷換一家，卻因已掛名落戶，無法脫離趙家.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 特首訪中亞
政正關你事 - 特首訪中亞
跑者愛也
programme.sub-title: 梁雍婷/一切從長跑開始
programme.desc: 第七集梁雍婷/一切從長跑開始. 〈跑者愛分享〉－梁雍婷. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與梁雍婷（Rachel）跑遍屯門海岸線。從海濱公園出發，經蝴蝶灣沙灘，終抵屯赤公園！伴隨著海水的氣息和無際的海景，Rachel分享跑步的純粹快樂：「對抗肌肉酸痛、找回呼吸節奏，喜歡挑戰自己的感覺！」海風伴著腳步，她笑著說：「跑步和演戲一樣，都要守住對事情的熱情！」能跑到老的答案很簡單，一起持續運動，腳步不停，熱情不熄！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－胸式呼吸 VS 腹式呼吸？. 跑步時總覺得呼吸急促、體力不足？你或許一直使用「胸式呼吸」，但你知道嗎，這種呼吸方式可能無法為肌肉提供足夠氧氣，讓你更容易感到疲累。「腹式呼吸」究竟有何神奇之處？如何透過簡單練習，提升跑步表現，讓呼吸更順暢、更輕鬆？. 〈一切從長跑開始〉. 長沙灣天主教英文中學最著名就是學校的長跑文化，創校初年已推行圍繞校園跑 25 圈的傳統，近年亦開始了中一生每天晨跑的習慣。長跑傳統如何孕育新一代，訓練出「自強不息」的特質？這是一個屬於長天長跑的故事.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 林奕匡(Phil)一直以來給觀眾的印象是一位溫柔細膩的唱作歌手。今集Phil 將徹底打破固有印象，帶領觀眾走進他音樂世界的另一面！除了延續過往動人的情感詮釋，林奕匡更挑戰全新曲風，展現出鮮有的狂野與自信。究竟「暖男」遇上「特務」會擦出怎樣的火花？. 主持. 阮頌陽. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《特務占士匡 Mad World》. 《那些不愛我的人.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 十九年前，劉麗珍Amy 確診柏金遜症，因為患者身體會出現不自主「郁動」，引來旁人一些不友善的目光。這些年來，Amy慢慢接受了身體的改變，注重儀態的她努力做運動減輕病況。今集主持愛美會和她們一班柏友乒乓球友傾下計.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影：孤男寡女
programme.desc: 營業助理 Kinki (鄭秀文飾)工作上「安份守己」,但一次人事變動,她被調到華少(劉德華飾)部門.起初, Kinki 聽聞華少風流成性,對他避忌三分.但共事後,他們漸漸了解對方,她開始欣賞華少辦事認真,以及對感情的執著,即使面對辦公室的閒言冷語,也未損二人感情.然而,他與舊愛阿茵若即若離,令 Kinki 不敢釋放那股對愛情的渴求.此時,年青有為的 Roger 向 Kinki 求婚,她又如何在二人間作抉擇.

programme.title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了嶺南大學科學教研部助理教授李灝博士及博士研究生張順智，分享有關蜂類和蜂巢的知識。本集以虎斑細腰蜾蠃、黃柄壁泥蜂及炫長腹土蜂作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索蜂類的外貌特徵、生活習性、蜂巢構造以及生存智慧.

programme.title: 棋士
programme.desc: 公安局內，秦曉銘被視為第五名在逃劫犯，去向疑是昆明或南寧，甚至可能只是用來誤導。崔業與夏生掩埋屍體後去媽祖廟求心安，夏生卻問到啟示：既已金蟬脫殼，不如借圍棋思維賺大錢。崔業只想止損，卻被推向成人班與王紅羽的賭局。對手竟是昔日師哥董炳輝，崔業設局獲勝，卻只換來一部走私手機。帳本揭出王紅羽非法斂財，兒子又確診運動神經元病，巨額治療費壓垮崔業。淑華來電求去國外並逼離婚，理想與現實齊齊翻覆，崔業終於下定決心改變.

programme.title: 留學香港。話你知
programme.desc: The 2024 Policy Address outlined plans to build Hong Kong into a global hub for higher education. Connect with students from around the world and delve into their stories and experiences. Discover why Hong Kong is an ideal destination for post-secondary education and a place of opportunities.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 你可有試過，在忙碌的一天裡，突然被一把聲音打動？可能是親友傳來的一段錄音，可能是電視中的一句歌詞，亦可能是一個陌生人在音訊節目裡的說話。. 近年愈來愈多人選擇用音訊節目去跟大眾分享，利用這個以聲音為主的媒介，吸引大家聽他們的製作。數年前開始，Candy在音訊節目平台經營訪談頻道，邀請不同職業的人分享他們的故事。她相信聲音是一種能量，可以一直流傳在這個世上；兩位相識於中學的好朋友加一和阿妍，在工餘時間經常相約一同錄製節目，希望把她們的想法、興趣與笑聲，傳送給更多人；兒童廣播劇創作者阿粒，六年來製作了三百多集節目，陪伴著孩子成長、學習，甚至面對傷心、恐懼等不同的情緒。. 這些故事沒有畫面，只有聲音。但正因為如此，聽眾反而可能更能收獲一份不一樣的陪伴與共鳴.

programme.title: 千年陝菜
programme.desc: 燒烤作為「火烹法」之一，歷史悠久。老安是西安市長安區花園村村民，為招待老友的到來，他擺起了家宴，並親自上手展示自己的絕活——燒烤。安康一家傳統老菜餐館主廚的絕技是用「油烹法」漲發魚肚。明清年間，閩粵移民遷居陝南，無法獲得海魚，從此，早年無人問津的漢江魚鰾就變得金貴起來。這種因地制宜的改良也促成一道經典陝菜紅燒魚肚的誕生.

programme.title: 千年陝菜
programme.desc: 秦嶺以南的漢中盆地水量充沛，是藏在大山深處的「嶺上江南」。這裏也是陝西水稻的主產區，尤其以洋縣黑米最為獨特。為陝菜增添了一份獨特的風味。傳統陝菜「長安糟肉」煥發出新的生機.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 2022年，北海道相繼建立了農業設施。在北海道大學設施入面，參觀者可以體驗最新的遙控技術。面在北廣島久保田農業前線，亦以觀察最新的蔬菜種植技術.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 莎莎最近比較煩，店鋪裝修陳舊招攬不來生意，家庭收入嚴重入不敷出，兩個孩子和灶君不省心，逸飛也不幫忙，大家還指著莎莎調解自己的問題，莎莎不堪重擔，崩潰離家出走，被安裝解除煩惱插件的子龍感知莎莎需求，不僅幫莎莎變新了店鋪還將莎莎的煩惱根源的記憶剔除.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 看到莎莎失控出走，一家人終於去找莎莎，沒想到一出門卻被子龍用神力丟進垃圾桶。為求真相眾人回家中，可還沒等搞清狀況幾人又被子龍丟進垃圾桶。眾人設計控制子龍觀看莎莎的記憶，得知莎莎的煩惱，最後在家人們齊心協力下莎莎恢復記憶，一家人也懂得彼此體諒.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 大周周表演魔術時，貓咪中途跑了，演出面臨危機。菲菲召集如福去找貓，卻被朝風抓走。於是，如福們追上朝風，展開了一場舞台下的打鬥追逐。這場意外讓演出意外成功.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 榮老闆拒絕歸還汪大夫的古董秤砣，菲菲決定幫忙。她假裝找到秤砣，榮老闆不信，趁無人之際掀開地磚拿出盒子，這一切被如福看見。第二天，秤砣回到汪大夫手中.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: The government has announced 30 measures to be implemented by the task force promoting the silver economy, including initiatives to attract the elderly into the labor market, which are expected to increase the elderly labor participation rate to over 10%, thereby reducing the pressure on medical and welfare expenditures. To enhance the incentives for the elderly to re-enter the workforce, the Labour Department's "Middle-aged and Elderly Employment Programme" and the Employees Retraining Board's "Post-50" programme provide systematic training and internships for the elderly, and subsidize employers who hire elderly interns. This episode will cover the training situation of the elderly, and the bureau will also share the content and effectiveness of the programme.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.desc: 活動由保良局舉辦，以「實踐低碳生活、維護生態安全」為主題，透過多元化的表演及攤位遊戲，讓學生明白可持續發展的生活方式與維護國家生態安全的關係和重要性，鼓勵大家培養低碳生活的習慣.

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第八集應智越/定向人生跑. 〈跑者愛分享〉－應智越. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與唱作人應智越（細猫）並肩踏上啟德跑道。從紅白信號台出發，經海濱花園直達空中花園！這條模仿舊機場打造的跑道，如同他的追夢旅程：只要腳步不停，總能起飛。細猫將耳機裡的熱血化為動力：「音樂推著我向前，連情緒都跟著激昂！」衝過終點線是跑步最滿足的瞬間，累積的疲累在此刻一掃而空！就像創作，每天堅持多跑一步，終會找到自己的節奏！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－良好跑姿，如何打開髖關節？. 你跑步時是否經常感到步伐沉重、效率不足？原來打開髖關節是提升跑姿的關鍵秘訣！Inez將會教你幾個簡單的動態伸展動作，幫助你更有效地增加步幅、提升推送力，更省力地輕鬆奔跑。. 〈定向人生跑〉. 林楚茹（Harmony）作為中國香港定向代表隊成員，畢業後兼顧工作，加上近年轉向投入越野跑，在跑界中嶄露頭角成為矚目生力軍之一，到底工作、定向、越野跑三者之中她如何取得平衡？在寶貴的時間中她是如何取捨她的理想人生.

棋士
programme.sub-title: 第四集：優秀企業家背後走私
programme.desc: 阿寬母親因阿茲海默症認錯人，把阿寬趕出家門。崔偉協助演戲喚回記憶，兩人互換身份騙過其母；事後崔偉獲得新線索：秦曉銘事發前一週在“大世界”見過王紅羽的司機鄺志國。崔偉進一步調查鄺志國，鄰居稱其生活糜爛、數日前未再歸家，欲向趙局通報卻被因紅羽集團影響面大而暫緩。另一方面，崔業從刷機手機店入手，埋伏一次性相機蒐證倒賣水貨；卻被夏生一路跟著，仍想要挾王紅羽換錢。崔業追到交易與運貨線索後被發現、遭打昏押上漁船，生死一刻夏生救回他。兩人決意與王紅羽“勢不兩立”，踏上報仇之路.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
演藝盛薈: 香港電台音樂會@前海
programme.desc: 《香港電台音樂會@前海》於深圳萬象前海天幕廣場舉行，由前海管理局與香港電台首度合辦。音樂會雲集兩地頂尖的音樂家，透過美妙的旋律演繹深港文化交織，為觀眾呈獻一場跨地域文化交融的音樂盛宴。. 合辦：. 深圳市前海深港現代服務業合作區管理局. 香港電台. 場地提供：. 萬象前海. 演出：. RedBricks Harmonica（葉梓翀、蔡偉鏗、葉進禧、鄭智源）. 笙與民樂小組（盧思泓、容寶汶、曾柏榆、翟悅敏）. 聲樂精選（葉葆菁、蔡繼瑜、梁展維）. 演出曲目：. 數字人生 Minuet by Bach/Petzold. 古典套曲 Classical Medley （香港電台第四台特別委約創作）. 吉卜賽套曲 Gypsy Medley. 拉德斯基進行曲 Radetzky March. 紫竹調. 彩雲追月. 賽馬. 阿細歡歌. 金蛇狂舞. 漫步街上 Quando men vo . 吻 II Bacio. 別君嘆. 秋風詞. 春風，你為何喚醒. Over the Rainbow. 相對無語 Lippen Schweigen. 飲酒歌 Libiamo.

programme.title: 2025-26香港足球明星選舉頒獎典禮
2025-26香港足球明星選舉頒獎典禮
programme.sub-title: 2025-26香港足球明星選舉頒獎典禮
programme.desc: 香港足球明星選舉是本港一項一年一度舉行的足球頒獎禮，以表揚一眾教練與球員過去一個球季的出色表現。今年的頒獎典禮定於 2026年5月31日在香港會議展覽中心舉行，共設 18 個獎項.

programme.title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團山東篇 — 曲阜、泰安
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.sub-title: 第十九集: 忙碌的情侶想坐下來好好談談
programme.desc: 許子詮和唐影二人都工作繁忙，見面越來越少，二人想要找個機會好好聊聊，但是一直找不到合適的時間。林心姿受邀去酒吧觀看夏天駐唱期間再度被裝腔男搭訕，夏天看到不高興。愛慕許子詮的女性直接登門，許子詮讓唐影直接退敵.

31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 晨光初破，城市蘇醒，細膩如紗的「舞者」飄散出第一縷香氣。當輕柔的面片經過發酵的魔法變得鬆軟而有彈性，當第一次有人將菜或肉包裹其中而食，一種便捷小巧蘊藏無限驚喜的食物出現。早餐包點，口味多變，均衡的營養組合又不失嚴謹，它是早餐界的「顯眼包」，和朝陽共舞，只要一口咬下，喚醒味蕾的樂章便悄然流淌.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 湯，這種古老的食品，卻在現代人的早餐中意外「翻紅」。不論是南方的雋永清澈，還是北方的踏實飽腹，湯總是以海納百川的包容性，迎合著每一個地方的食俗、每一種口味的變化。一碗湯下肚，從舌尖暖到心底.

programme.sub-title: 第五集：陳麥冬主動向莊潔道歉
programme.desc: 鎮廣播站播放對陳麥冬的感謝信—這是陳奶奶為了“推銷”他而促成的。莊潔也在幫鎮推銷山藥時聽到。很快，鎮廣播裡也播放了對莊潔的感謝信。陳奶奶借慶祝把莊潔約到家裏，但陳麥冬和莊潔再次不歡而散。陳麥冬主動道歉，兩人吃飯時終於交心，但莊潔也快要回上海了.

programme.title: 春色寄情人
programme.sub-title: 第六集：莊潔衝動吻陳麥冬被瘋傳
programme.desc: 莊潔一時衝動吻陳麥冬的場面，被乘客拍下，在南枰瘋傳，令二人很崩潰。陳麥冬加班時，見到了一個被父母遺棄、又剛經歷了奶奶離世的小男孩，陳麥冬仿佛看到了自己。莊潔告訴王西夏，她確實喜歡陳麥冬，可她更喜歡上海和自己。之後，莊潔想聯繫陳麥冬道歉，卻發現陳麥冬.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 英雄們很久沒有接到任務，他們的鋒芒快要消逝之際，菲斯偽造出一隻奇怪又可怕的怪物，並表示這怪物正在破壞森林，欺騙英雄們去執行任務，消滅怪物。然而，菲斯很快就後悔設下這個詭計.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥急於品嚐蛋糕，但被燙到。姐弟倆前往史前世界，遇到雷卡，他在等待恐龍蛋孵化。他們嘗試用樹葉和朋友幫助，但都失敗了，後來享受與奶昔打球的樂趣。不久，雷卡的恐龍弟弟破殼而出，大家熱烈慶祝.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥和小米邊吃爆谷邊看恐龍電影，但不甘心去睡。小麥偷偷跑到史前時代，讓大家四處尋找他。最終，小米聽見呼救，帶大家找到小麥，但意外掉進火山，哆來咪飛起來救出他們.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君原計劃向天庭申請調離趙家，天庭同意並派車接他。然而，住了幾日後，灶君逐漸對趙家產生感情，決定幫忙完成訂單上的元宵。沒想到，他坐錯車，不僅沒回天庭，還錯把湯圓送到天庭.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：馬英杰動了復婚的心思
programme.desc: 馬英杰覺得和曉薇關係緩和了，再次動了說服曉薇復婚的心思。曉薇在糖豆的推波助瀾下，也貌似動了心思。馬英杰以馬母想孫子為由，說能否請曉薇帶着糖豆來吃頓飯。曉薇想了想，答應了。誰知，馬英杰媽媽依舊趾高氣揚.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
31看世界 - 醫學先鋒
programme.sub-title: 修復心臟 Fix The Heart
programme.desc: 如果將來心臟衰竭不再致命，會是甚麼光景？三位極具遠見的科研人員，踏上修復心臟創新之路。. 安琪拉瑪斯，荷蘭婦解分子及心臟科專家，致力專注治療女性的心臟疾病；艾倫克里比埃，傑出的發明家，他研發的瓣膜，開拓了無須重大手術治療心臟病的革命之路；阿蘭卡龐蒂埃，得到市場營運專家皮亞和格里梅的輔助，破天荒成功開發全人工心臟。. 他們挑戰一貫被視為難以打破的醫療局限，最終圓夢，為無數患者帶來希望。. What if tomorrow, heart failure was no longer a fatality? Three visionary researchers have embarked on the path of innovation to repair hearts. Angela Maas, a Dutch feminist cardiologist, is committed to treating women's hearts; Alain Cribier, the brilliant inventor of revolutionary valves, has made it possible to operate on hearts without major surgery; and Alain Carpentier, for his part, wanted to create a completely artificial heart. With M Piat and Grimme. This first episode of the series Medical Pioneers, Curing the Incurable takes us on a journey to discover their amazing work, opening up medical possibilities that often seemed unreachable, even in the wildest dreams. These medical superheroes give hope to millions of patients.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：馬英杰動了復婚的心思
programme.desc: 馬英杰覺得和曉薇關係緩和了，再次動了說服曉薇復婚的心思。曉薇在糖豆的推波助瀾下，也貌似動了心思。馬英杰以馬母想孫子為由，說能否請曉薇帶着糖豆來吃頓飯。曉薇想了想，答應了。誰知，馬英杰媽媽依舊趾高氣揚.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
雙城記-兩岸主播逛香港
programme.desc: 《兩岸主播逛香港》的主題是「不一樣的香港」，系列分為兩集。第一集《博物館之旅》圍繞香港眾多精彩的博物館展開介紹：通過香港文化博物館、九龍寨城這兩個頗具香港本土文化來向觀眾展現原汁原味的香港特色，也希望能讓觀眾通過港片、港娛、港產等，進一步加深對香港的認識和瞭解。同時，香港的博物館也特別注重親子體驗感和國際感的打造，讓成人和孩童都能夠從中找到自己的興趣所在。這次特別選取三家：香港鐵路博物館、香港科學館、香港太空館，通過互動及精彩的展品，讓觀眾獲得意想不到的收穫.

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.sub-title: 第二十集: 愛不是名詞，是個動詞
programme.desc: 忙碌的工作造成了唐影突然失聰，康復期間讓唐影和許子詮兩個人都對自己的生活有了很深的反思，甚麼才是最重要的。夜晚，林心姿獨自在家，家中意外停電，夏天主動給了林心姿安心，兩人情感再度升溫。[全劇完.

春色寄情人
programme.sub-title: 第七集：莊潔的繼父意外離世
programme.desc: 莊潔的繼父意外離世，莊趕到南枰殯儀館，痛失親生父親的車禍夢魘再湧。理容室裏，陳麥冬給強撐堅強的莊媽媽介紹面部修容的技術，請她節哀。莊媽媽只表示丈夫人為細緻，求陳麥冬照顧好他。莊的弟妹趕到，妹妹説：“我也沒有爸爸了嗎？.

programme.title: 春色寄情人
programme.sub-title: 第八集：莊潔妹妹離家岀走
programme.desc: 葬禮後的一周，莊潔弟妹都被媽媽趕回學校。她讓莊潔也趕緊回上海，表示他們必須克服。莊潔表示自己回上海交接完工作就回來，她們一起撐過去。好友幫莊潔收拾，表示會替她盯着公司。莊潔欲回南枰之際，卻接到了媽媽電話：妹妹獨自離家出走，來上海了。莊潔感到心急如焚.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 英雄們在一次任務過程中，意識到胡飛出現了問題，他好像完全失去了自信。幾位英雄為了幫助朋友並完成任務，帶著胡飛前往自信山，幫助他找回自信.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 晚上，小米發現小麥不見了，驚慌地四處尋找，卻無法找到他。被自己的尖叫驚醒的小麥安慰她，姐弟倆決定去恐龍世界。那裡朋友們圍著營火講故事，分享美好的夢。小米聽完後感到放鬆，決定講述自己在無盡圖書館的夢。蛋仔提醒他們該回家了，鼓勵珍藏美好回憶。小米心滿意足地入睡，臉上帶著微笑.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米和小麥玩《小紅帽》，小麥偏離劇情讓小紅帽吃掉大野狼，惹怒小米。她去恐龍世界重新演繹故事，小麥追隨而來。排練混亂，小米怒氣離開，後來在山洞遇到阿福，學會了深呼吸技巧，平靜後回去道歉，並重新享受演出的樂趣.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君和子軒獨留在家，遇到上門盜寶的古董大盜，為了守護家庭財產，灶君子軒與陰險狡詐的古董大盜鬥智斗勇，最終智取古董大盜將他送交警察，子軒和灶君也產生了深厚感情.

programme.title: 雙城記-兩岸主播逛香港
programme.desc: 第二集《發現屯門》通過講述屯門的過去、現在，及未來的展望，來發現「不一樣的香港」。兩岸三地的主持人，與嘉賓一起搭上屯馬線及輕鐵，探訪屯門的宜居和交通便捷，同時還有連接內地的地理優勢。通過走訪掃管笏遺址、有「香港千島湖」之稱的大纜涌，屯門陶淵明後人聚居區——藍地等處，帶觀眾瞭解屯門名字的由來，以及過去在香港的地位和作用。而三聖邨，黃金海岸旅遊區、屯門公園、藝術新地標等地，則展現屯門有別於香港市區不同又獨具魅力的自然風光景色.

programme.title: 三叉戟 2
programme.sub-title: 第十集：三叉戟尋人遇陷阱
programme.desc: 貸款公司已人去樓空，三叉戟以追債業務合作的名義接觸幕後的放數人。主腦正想逃跑之際，徐蔓單人匹馬追捕!三叉戟在治安隊隊長的幫助下，得知了廖莎莎的住處並趕到該處，原來是個賣淫地方，更墮入設局捉姦的陷阱.

programme.title: 去桃花盛開的地方
programme.sub-title: 第一集：叛逆少女藏地奇遇
programme.desc: 丁念跟父親老丁吵架，離家出走一路西行，來到了媽媽的故鄉－位於西藏林芝的嘎拉村，探尋自己的身世之謎.

programme.title: 去桃花盛開的地方
programme.sub-title: 第二集：射箭烏龍 情緣初現
programme.desc: 丁念隨元氣大廚孫芊芊採蘑菇遇險，被藏族青年索朗射箭誤傷。索朗送丁念回客棧，孫芊芊提議丁念手繪菜單獲得萍姐支持。老雷暗訪客棧，偷拍丁念歡笑畫面。餐後丁念為卓瑪畫像驚艷眾人.

programme.title: 去桃花盛開的地方
programme.sub-title: 第三集： 畫像引爆桃花緣
programme.desc: 入住情侶小葉大魏因旅遊瑣事激烈爭吵。索朗巧妙安排大魏藏裝騎馬，帶小葉另闢蹊徑終見南迦巴瓦峰美景，兩人浪漫破冰。丁念將兩人騎馬背影與神山畫成肖像作為禮物.

programme.title: 去桃花盛開的地方
programme.sub-title: 第四集：點亮夢想 曖昧升級
programme.desc: 索朗帶丁念郊遊，浪漫講述「尼蘭木」童年奇遇，兩人情愫暗湧。張浩然將丁念畫作投入文創開發，丁念才華首獲認可！卓瑪熱情邀丁念擔任小學書畫比賽代課老師，曾抗拒父親安排的丁念陷入掙扎。丁建國得知女兒行蹤.

春色寄情人
programme.sub-title: 第九集：莊潔協助重開家業
programme.desc: 鹵雞店翻新，重新開業打折酬賓。莊潔找了網紅實地取材，做了宣傳。網絡直播賣雞的效果不錯，一家人忙着填快遞單。陳麥冬發現早餐又是陳奶奶為了幫襯莊潔家買的雞，不由得抱怨快吃吐了。陳奶奶盛讚莊潔母女。陳麥冬只關心莊潔還會否回上海.

programme.title: 春色寄情人
programme.sub-title: 第十集：前曖昧對象示好
programme.desc: 莊潔的前曖昧對象季仝出差回國，得知莊潔繼父去世後，又於心不忍，找好友打探情況。好友表示莊潔的事不勞他費心，還將莊潔與陳麥冬的吻照呈上。前曖昧對象驚訝之餘，不甘心就此失去莊潔，主動來南枰示好。莊潔對對方的心思了然於心，半開玩笑問妹妹自己該怎麼辦.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 英雄們造訪威茲波普的麵包店，品嚐他的魔法蛋糕，他們發現蛋白棒裡有會令人大喊的提子乾、忌廉撻亦硬得像石頭、海綿蛋糕則不斷飄走！阿菇決心解開這個謎團，但不小心掉進了威茲波普的隱形麵粉中，究竟他如何引起大家的注意.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 在暴風雨的夜晚，小米害怕雷聲，小麥卻享受。回到史前世界發現缺水，恐龍不高興。小米跑進山洞遇到沙沙羅，雷卡幫助她克服恐懼.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米因未能得到超強光手電筒而沮喪，小麥提議回到史前時代。大家想組建樂團但沒有樂器，小麥敲打風樹果實，引來三葉蟲，沙沙羅嚇跑它們。最後，大家用自然聲音創造樂器，小米回家後製作出超強光手電筒.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 在跳格子大賽中，灶君向土地公求助，意外損壞重力系統，導致小鎮重力異常。子涵憑藉堅韌意志克服重力贏得比賽，最終兩女孩和解，灶君及時恢復重力.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第二十八集：家長們的工作被檢閱
programme.desc: 有關學校的任何通知，外公戴富國一看見，就馬上截圖，並轉發到群組裏。爺爺嫲嫲、外公外婆們自此每天都按着通知的內容，檢閱家長們的工作。家長群裏的家長們全都莫名其妙地想：「怎麼爺爺嫲嫲們什麼都知道？.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 現代歷史曾將伊朗及其豐富而獨特的遺產深藏於內，但如今這個國家終於向世界敞開了大門。 德黑蘭擁有800萬居民，是一座現代化的城市，其熱情好客的居民，恰好靠近眾多大受歡迎的冬季運動勝地。從德黑蘭向北前往裏海地區，茶田和稻田交替著出現，當地是伊朗的糧倉。絕對不能錯過的是伊斯法罕，當地擁有精心建造的清真寺。還有被稱為「沙漠城市鎮」的雅茲德也是遊人必到之處，它被認為是世界上最古老的城市之一。而更加著名的是波斯波利斯的考古遺址，其重要性及遺跡的品質，可說是無與論比的。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年9月10日 星期二晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 中醫藥旗艦展新篇
programme.desc: 香港一直推動中醫藥傳承與發展。隨著香港首間中醫醫院成立，期望在醫療、教學、科研三方面取得突破，並致力打造中西醫協作的香港模式，聯動多方協作，創造健康價值。香港中醫醫院在國家及特區政府大力支持下，努力提升中醫藥發展，讓香港成為中醫藥走向世界的橋頭堡.

programme.title: 去桃花盛開的地方
programme.sub-title: 第五集： 身世疑雲籠罩
programme.desc: 丁念因眾人的鼓勵，解開心結，在教學中重拾繪畫初心。索朗邀丁念見家長，二人月下夜談情感升溫。張浩然提議合作萍姐家傳桃花酒配方，卻牽出其丈夫泥石流失蹤的隱密往事。老村長記憶混亂提及「泥石流」，丁念身世疑雲再起.

programme.title: 去桃花盛開的地方
programme.sub-title: 第六集：甜蜜藏危機 身世迷霧重重
programme.desc: 丁念與索朗的「一家三口」視頻爆火網絡。在篝火晚會上老村長突喊丁念母親名字「次央」，丁念身世線索浮現.

programme.title: 去桃花盛開的地方
programme.sub-title: 第七集：父女衝突起 舊夢藏玄機
programme.desc: 老雷透露丁建國與丁念母親次央的戀愛往事，卻迴避死亡真相。丁建國嚴防死守索朗，但老村長探病突喊「孫媳婦」，丁建國警覺。暗藏多年的秘密呼之欲出.

programme.title: 去桃花盛開的地方
programme.sub-title: 第八集：謎團漸清晰 曖昧大升級
programme.desc: 老丁留藏陪伴女兒。萍姐向丁建國吐露堅守客棧是為等泥石流失蹤的丈夫歸來，丁念偷聽觸動。丁念反思與父親關係，索朗暖心安慰，星空下曖昧升溫.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
春色寄情人
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：陳麥冬問莊潔有沒有對自己動過心
programme.desc: 莊潔的媽媽走入家中，說陳麥冬奶奶闖進别人家裏。莊潔打探，得知是因為陳麥冬昨晚和人打架，這才導致陳奶奶一大早衝到人家裏親自對決。莊潔第一時間到家中探望陳麥冬，祖孫倆明顯還在鬥氣，讓她去喊陳麥冬吃飯。陳麥冬見到莊潔，單刀直入，問她有沒有對自己動過心思.

programme.title: 春色寄情人
programme.sub-title: 第十二集： 陳麥冬說媒被拒
programme.desc: 莊潔看出陳麥冬仍對原生家庭有陰影。於是循循善誘，勸慰陳麥冬：長大成人是精神上的，而非年齡。應該去愛一個人，而非等待被愛。陳麥冬主動找到長輩替自己去莊家說媒。長輩來到莊家，與莊潔的媽媽打啞謎般說媒被拒，並通知了陳麥冬。陳麥冬表面冷靜，內心翻江倒海.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 仙子小隊被臭鼬的黏黏臭彈攻擊，以致無法飛行，此時，胡飛帶領英雄們繼續任務，結束臭鼬對森林的臭彈攻擊.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米和小麥觀星，小米說星星有六個角，被蛋仔引導到史前世界。他們與恐龍追逐流星，最終發現流星只是一塊岩石。雖然小米尷尬，但他們明白最美好的願望是與朋友共享冒險.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥、小米和茜茜畫畫，茜茜因色鉛筆壞了不想繼續。姐弟倆帶她去史前世界參加恐龍的水彩畫。胖殼因顏色不合適而沮喪，茜茜鼓勵他享受過程，最終胖殼勇敢作畫，大家快樂回憶冒險，並繼續創作.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 為了逃避大掃除，灶君裝病被送去藥店，遇到虛弱的神仙藥罐君。灶君施法將藥罐君變成自己，卻無法產出病因，被接回趙家。逸飛為灶君充能，灶君不得不隱藏身份，掩蓋真相.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第二十九集：楊明彪體檢三高
programme.desc: 戴靜叮囑丈夫要注意身體，彼此要互相監督鍛鍊。同時，兩人商量決定對給患癌同學捐款一事先不表態。高宇軒媽媽見群內無人響應，又開始了新一輪的號召。另一邊廂楊明彪體檢結果是「三高」，太太景婷婷甚為緊張.

programme.desc: 萍姐挖出珍藏多年的亡夫桃花酒贈予丁念父女。丁念向父親坦誠留藏決心，老丁欣慰放手。丁念回應索朗告白，坦然接受這段春日限定愛情.

programme.title: 春色寄情人
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：陳麥冬奶奶的好友病重
programme.desc: 陳麥冬到海濱浴場是為處理突發事件—年輕情侶衝浪，男孩喪命。男孩的母親怒斥是女孩害死了兒子。這令陳麥冬想起了已故的好友。陳麥冬回家告訴奶奶，很多親屬都希望最後一程也由自己來送。陳麥冬奶奶的好友—林奶奶突然病重，被醫院接走。之前不知情的陳奶奶也失蹤了.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥的牙齒鬆動了，展示後就掉了，讓他傷心。他們到史前世界找牙齒，遇到因毯子破而難過的沙沙羅。小麥借了沙沙羅和阿福的牙齒，但都不合適，還被牙齒仙子搶走。最後，他們用木瓜毛編織新毯子，小麥明白了道理，決定收藏掉落的牙齒.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小麥在臥室玩，不願意洗澡，認為自己乾淨。他啟動蛋仔到史前時代，被紅豆和綠豆弄髒。臭味引來昆蟲，逃跑後躺在灌木叢裡。聽到木瓜提醒，他驚慌逃回家，明白了洗澡的重要性.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 逸飛忘記結婚紀念日這讓莎莎很生氣，眼看父母愛情受到嚴重考驗、家庭和諧受到威脅，灶君帶領子軒子涵找月老幫忙，為父母愛情護航.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第三十集：果寧發展代打遊戲眾籌
programme.desc: 果寧決定透過協助其他人代打遊戲眾籌買遊戲造型。他又向果寶、初一和戴兵等人推介代打可以賺錢。爸爸劉向上在家長群裏得知果寶幫果寧發展代打眾籌一事，正準備詢問果寶之際，卻接到了李老師的電話….

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 清晨山野裏、市井中，早起的人們走向那一份份熟悉的味道。米粉源自中國古老稻作文明的味覺密碼，以水潤米香、柔韌細膩的姿態，悄然佔據了不少人的三餐之始。米粉那種與生俱來的「和諧」共性，使它能與天南地北的各味食材攜手，「纏綿」出獨特的一方風味.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 晨曦初破，當第一縷陽光穿透薄霧，喚醒沉睡的大地，中國的各個角落正上演著一場場用來開啟新一天的美食儀式。而這儀式中，有一種味道跨越千年的時光溫暖了無數人的胃與心，那就是雞蛋.
